name: Chrome DevTools
description: Lets your coding agent control and inspect a live Chrome browser using Chrome DevTools.

settings.label: Isolated profile
settings.help: Use a temporary user-data-dir that is cleaned up when the browser closes.

settings.label: Chrome channel
settings.help: Optional: stable, beta, dev or canary. Defaults to stable.

settings.label: Browser URL
settings.help: Optional: connect to a running, debuggable Chrome instance, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9222
